description: [Kyreos, 0.01 USDC via x402] POSTs a real JSON-RPC initialize to up to 25 MCP endpoints; returns up/auth/broken/down, HTTP status, latency, and the error snippet. Status 200 alone is not counted as up. Input: {"urls":["https://your-server/mcp"]}. Call once to get the payment terms; call again with x_payment (the signed x402 payment) to get the result.

x_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload for the terms returned on the first call

name: kyreos_mcp_liveness_probe
